subject: general
question: The Population Census, 2027, will include which major new component for the first time since 1931?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Caste-based enumeration**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The upcoming **Population Census**, which was delayed from its **2021** schedule due to the pandemic and is now expected to be conducted starting in **2025** with a target completion in **2027**, will include **Caste-based enumeration** for the first time in independent India's decadal census history.
 
• While **Scheduled Castes (SC)** and **Scheduled Tribes (ST)** have been counted in every census since **1951**, the detailed counting of other caste groups, particularly **Other Backward Classes (OBCs)**, has not been part of the regular decadal census since **1931** during the British colonial era. ***Hence, the statement regarding Caste-based enumeration is correct.***
 
• The **Census of India** is a massive exercise conducted under the provisions of the **Census Act, 1948**, which provides the legal framework for the collection of data and ensures the **confidentiality** of information provided by citizens.
 
• This specific census exercise is significant as it transitions into a **Digital Census**, where data will be collected using mobile
